title: Coinmonke Spider
description: A TheCymera minecraft-spider fork reworked into a Coinmonke-inspired hunter
body:
# 🕷️ Coinmonke Spider

**Coinmonke Spider** adds a huge, animated spider that actively hunts players. It is a heavily modified fork of **Minecraft Spider** by **TheCymaera/Heledron**, redesigned to resemble the spider seen in Coinmonke videos.

## ✨ Features

- 🕷️ Fully animated spider with eight long legs
- 🏃 Fast and aggressive player-chasing AI
- 📏 Grows from scale `3.0` to `6.0`
- ⚡ Temporarily adjusts its size and speed based on distance
- 🧗 Can climb walls
- 💥 Deals `15` damage per hit by default
- 🌑 Mostly made from netherite blocks
- 🎭 Extremely rare permanent camouflage
- ⏱️ Encounters last randomly between 1 and 2 minutes
- 🎲 Random configurable spawn intervals
- 🤖 Two available variants: `spider` and `spider-robot`
- 🛡️ Does not destroy blocks or damage the world

## 🕸️ Encounters

The spider can automatically appear near a random eligible player. After spawning, it immediately selects its target and begins chasing them.

It starts at scale `3.0` and later grows to scale `6.0`. When the player gets far away, the spider can temporarily increase its size and speed to catch up. It returns to its normal size after reducing the distance.

Large forms have a scale-adjusted attack range, allowing the spider to damage players standing directly underneath its body.

## 🤖 Spider Variants

Choose the model in `config.yml`:

```yaml
spider-type: "spider"
Available values:
spider — the classic eight-legged Coinmonke Spider
spider-robot — a mechanical spider using the 3.0 model
Restart the server after changing the spider type.

⚙️ Configuration
The configuration allows you to customize:
Automatic spawn intervals
Spawn chance
Encounter duration
Starting and final scale
Movement speed and acceleration
Damage and attack cooldown
Attack range for large forms
Adaptive maximum size
Camouflage chance
Spider variant
Wall climbing

🎮 Commands
/coinmonkespider spawn
/coinmonkespider despawn
/coinmonkespider reload
Commands require operator permissions by default.

📦 Requirements
Paper 1.21.3 or newer
Java 21 or newer
Server-side installation only
No client-side mods or resource packs required

📥 Installation
Download CoinmonkeSpider-1.0.0.jar.
Place it inside your server's plugins folder.
Start or restart the Paper server.
Customize the generated config.yml.
Run /coinmonkespider reload after changing the configuration.

⚠️ Important Information
The spider does not modify or destroy terrain.
Performance may depend on server hardware and the number of active entities.
This plugin is designed for horror events, survival servers, challenges, and videos.
Back up your configuration before updating the plugin.

❤️ Credits
This project is a fork of Minecraft Spider by TheCymaera/Heledron. It has been modified and expanded to create an experience inspired by the spider featured in Coinmonke videos.
